interpretation: Mixed result: fresh performed exact/root/triad-projection/pitch-class similarity improve; instructed exact, instructed projection and instructed pitch-class similarity regress. This does not establish professional-quality chord recognition of arbitrary songs.
sourceBundleHashDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact sorted JSON mapping every listed relative source path to its SHA256; includes all Rust sources, Cargo manifest/lock and model provenance/license files

metricDefinitions.exactRootAndFormula: Duration-weighted identical enharmonic root and relative pitch-class formula. Slash bass is ignored; added/omitted notes and dominant/major sevenths remain distinct.
metricDefinitions.rootOnly: Duration-weighted identical enharmonic root, ignoring chord quality; N matches N only.
metricDefinitions.majorMinorProjection: Secondary triad score. Eligible references contain a complete unambiguous major (1,3,5) or minor (1,b3,5) triad. Other reference duration is explicitly excluded; non-projectable predictions count wrong.
metricDefinitions.pitchClassJaccard: Secondary harmonic similarity: mean intersection/union of absolute pitch-class sets. Can be high despite a wrong root or quality; not exact chord accuracy.

evaluationPolicy.unknownLabels: X in the reference is excluded and its duration is reported. X in predictions counts wrong on known reference chords. Unsupported chord syntax raises an error instead of being dropped.
evaluationPolicy.noChord: N is a known no-chord label: N matches N. N is excluded from the separately denominated major/minor projection because it contains no triad.
evaluationPolicy.predictionGaps: Missing prediction time counts wrong on known reference intervals and is reported in missingPredictionSeconds. Overlapping or invalid intervals fail validation.

productionNMeaning: Undetermined/no reliable chord; a prediction N does not prove silence or absence of harmony.

trainingOverlapCaveat: The new12 are held out from our decoder's current development, not certified unseen by Basic Pitch pretraining. GuitarSet was part of its training data; exact checkpoint track membership has not been established. Each cohort covers six performers and five styles, not twelve independent songs. Instructed and sheet-informed semi-automatic performed references remain separate. No accuracy claim for arbitrary full mixes follows.

sequenceComparisons.scope: Untimed event-order comparison only. No whole-song or duration-weighted accuracy follows. All structures reported, no best-structure selection.

baseline-v1.timingStatus: Untimed user-supplied chord order. It cannot support whole-song duration-weighted chord accuracy or transition-time accuracy. No section boundaries or E/Esus4 durations are assumed.
baseline-v1.comparisonPolicy: Only event-order edit counts against both structural variants. Ignore chord duration, merge consecutive identical canonical predictions, trim leading/trailing N only, retain internal N or X as explicit mismatch events. Report exact root/formula and root-only edit counts independently. Do not label an edit statistic as full-song chord accuracy.
baseline-v1.metricWarning: These are unit-cost ordered event edit counts, not duration-weighted accuracy. Counts describe one optimal alignment; no best structural variant is selected. Root-only sequences additionally merge consecutive equal roots.
